EventItemActionText:
The Board of Architectural Review met in regular session in the Vienna Town Hall, 127 Center Street, South Vienna, Virginia, with Paul Layer presiding as Chair.  The following members were present: Laine Hyde, Michael Cheselka, and Patty Hanley.  Roy Baldwin was absent.  Staff members Andrea West, Planner, and Sharmaine Abaied, Board Clerk were present.

Ms. Abaied called roll with Laine Hyde, Paul Layer, Michael Cheselka, and Patty Hanley being present and Roy Baldwin being absent.

Mr. Cheselka made a motion to approve the meeting minutes from June 2018

Ms. Hanley seconded the motion.

Motion: Cheselka
Second: Hanley
Approved: 4-0
Absent: Baldwin

Request for approval of two façade signs (panel replacement) for Aditi Indian Street Food (formerly Turmeric Indian Dining) and Aditi Spice Depot, and vinyl window decals for Crepe Amour at 405, 407 & 409 Maple Ave E, (Docket No. BAR-45-18), in the C-2 Commercial zoning district; filed by Srijith Suku, business owner.

Mr. Srijith Suku was present to represent his application. 

Ms. Hanley and Ms. Hyde commented that the presentation was very thorough and well thought out. 

Ms. Hyde made a motion that the request for approval of two façade signs (panel replacement) for Aditi Indian Street Food (formerly Turmeric Indian Dining) and Aditi Spice Depot, and vinyl window decals for Crepe Amour at 405, 407 & 409 Maple Ave E, (Docket No. BAR-45-18), be approved as submitted.

Motion: Hyde
Second: Cheselka
Approved: 4-0
Absent: Baldwin
EventItemTitle: 405, 407, & 409 Maple Ave E - Aditi Spice Depot and Crepe Amour - PF-44-18-BAR

EventItemActionText:
Request for approval of an awning sign for Moments of Peace Massage Therapy located at 502 Maple Avenue West, (Docket No. BAR-44-18), in the C-1 Commercial zoning district; filed by Ron Hu and Min Zhang, business owners, and Xinguan Signs.

Mr. Min Zhang was present to represent the awning sign application.

Ms. Hanley asked about the light fixture under the awning, which would be in conflict of the door.  Mr. Zhang stated the light would not be blocked.  There was continued discussion of the location of the canopy and the light.

Mr. Cheselka made a motion that the request for approval of an awning sign for Moments of Peace Massage Therapy located at 502 Maple Avenue West, (Docket No. BAR-44-18), be approved as submitted.

Motion: Cheselka
Second: Hanley
Approved:  4-0
Absent: Baldwin
EventItemTitle: 502 Maple Ave W - Moments of Peace Massage Therapy PF-44-18-BAR

EventItemActionText:
Request for approval of a façade sign, and freestanding sign reface, for Walgreens Pharmacy located at 225 Maple Ave E, (Docket No. BAR-39-18), in the C-2 Commercial zoning district; filed by Heather English of Permit Solutions on behalf of Allen Industries.

Mr. Gary Brent was present to represent the application.

Mr. Layer and Mr. Brent discussed the raceway that is typically behind the sign.  Mr. Brent stated the need for a raceway was to house components for the sign.  He continued stating the components now are slim enough that there is no need for a raceway.  There was continued discussion.    

Ms. Hanley made a motion that the request for approval of a façade sign, and freestanding sign reface, for Walgreens Pharmacy located at 225 Maple Ave E, (Docket No. BAR-39-18), be approved as submitted    

Motion:  Hanley
Second:  Hyde
Approved: 4-0
Absent:   Baldwin

Request for approval of a freestanding sign reface, and exterior modifications (paint), for Long and Foster Real Estate located at 309 Maple Avenue W, (Docket No. BAR-43-18) in the C-1 Commercial zoning district; filed by Fetneh Schacht of Long and Foster Real Estate.  

Ms. Fetneh Schact was present to represent her application.

Ms. Hanley asked if the monument sign beams would be painted.  Ms. Schact stated they would paint the beams, but the same color, black.  Ms. Hanley also asked if the Ashen Tan was the same as the color of the brick mortar and Ms. Schact stated it was.  

Mr. Cheselka commented on the paint colors and appreciated the updated colors.  

Ms. Hanley made a to approve request for a freestanding sign reface, and exterior modifications (paint), for Long and Foster Real Estate located at 309 Maple Avenue W, (Docket No. BAR-43-18), be approved as submitted.  

Motion: Cheselka
Second:  Hyde
Approved:  4-0
Absent:  Baldwin
EventItemTitle: 309 Maple Ave W - Long and Foster - PF-43-18-BAR

EventItemActionText:
Ms. Hyde made a motion to adjourn the meeting.  Mr. Cheselka seconded the motion.  The meeting adjourned at 8:28 PM.

Respectfully submitted by,
       
Sharmaine Abaied
Board Clerk
